points.title: Two spirit houses in the roadside greenery
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสองหลังในพุ่มไม้ริมทาง
points.notes: A gold-roofed San Phra Phum beside a white multi-tiered ancestor shrine, glimpsed through a hedge with offerings on the pedestals.

points.title: Rainbow cloth wrapped around a giant roadside tree
points.title_th: ผ้าแถบสีรุ้งพันรอบต้นไม้ใหญ่ริมทาง
points.notes: Multi-coloured striped cloth wound around the base of a massive old tree trunk beside the road, a sacred-tree marker.

points.title: Gold spirit house on a pillar outside a shophouse
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองตั้งบนเสาหน้าตึกแถว
points.notes: A tiered gold spirit house on its plinth at the entrance of the aluminium supply shop.

points.title: Gold spirit house under a shop arcade
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองใต้อาเขตร้านค้า
points.notes: A tiered gold spirit house on a white pedestal, sheltered under the arcade roof of a modern shop building.

points.title: Small roadside spirit house
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิเล็กๆ ริมถนน
points.notes: A small spirit house with offerings stands at the roadside near the Orbit eyewear shop; partly shaded but the figure and garlands are visible.

points.title: White-and-gold spirit house at a gate
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีขาวทองที่ประตูรั้ว
points.notes: A well-kept white-and-gold spirit house with a red offering bottle sits at the gate of a black corrugated-metal building; clean, well-lit, and unobstructed.

points.title: Twin gold spirit houses at the Eurasia Hotel corner
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิทองคู่ที่มุมโรงแรมยูเรเซีย
points.notes: An elaborate main spirit house and a smaller ศาลตายาย side by side at a street corner, offerings visible, a worker in a wide-brim hat tending them.

points.title: Spirit house by a furniture store
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิหน้าร้านเฟอร์นิเจอร์
points.notes: Small gold Phra Phum spirit house at the foot of the furniture store's entrance stairs, plants around its base.

points.title: Spirit house at a tractor dealership
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิหน้าร้านรถแทรกเตอร์
points.notes: A small spirit house with fresh offerings stands by the entrance of the New Holland tractor dealership, a modest but clear roadside shrine.

points.title: Ornate gold spirit house at a car garage
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองประดับหน้าอู่ซ่อมรถ
points.notes: A large, ornate gold spirit house with a tiered roof stands prominently in front of the DENSO/Castrol diesel service garage, well-lit and clearly the best-kept shrine seen on this stretch.

points.title: Golden spirit house on a machinery yard wall
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองบนกำแพงลานเครื่องจักร
points.notes: A gilt San Phra Phum spirit house perched on the blue-and-white perimeter wall of a construction-equipment yard, roofline catching the morning light.

points.title: Small gold spirit house glimpsed through trees
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองขนาดเล็กที่เห็นผ่านต้นไม้
points.notes: A small golden San Phra Phum with a garland, framed by banana leaves and palm trunks in a garden near the BMW dealership stretch.

points.title: Spirit house beside an auto parts shop
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิข้างร้านอะไหล่รถยนต์
points.notes: Small white spirit house with gold trim and a companion shrine at ground level beside the road, plain but clearly visible.

points.title: Gold shrine with a small elephant figure at a roadside property
points.title_th: ศาลเจ้าสีทองมีรูปช้างเล็กหน้าอาคารริมถนน
points.notes: Ornate gold shrine with parasol-topped spires, a small elephant statue, and offerings at the entrance of a walled property.

points.title: White statue on a pedestal at a garden restaurant entrance
points.title_th: รูปปั้นสีขาวบนแท่นที่ทางเข้าร้านอาหารสวน
points.notes: Small white statue on a plinth beside the gate of the Vanusnun garden restaurant, string lights overhead.

points.title: Spirit house at a tyre and service centre entrance
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิที่ทางเข้าศูนย์บริการยางและซ่อมรถ
points.notes: Plain white spirit house among plants beside the entrance of Goodyear Autocare, clearly visible.

points.title: A small gold spirit house behind the gate
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองหลังประตูรั้ว
points.notes: A small gold-roofed San Phra Phum stands on its pillar just inside a teal gate, Thai and religious flags flying above the fence beside it.

points.title: Small gilded spirit house behind the greenery
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองหลังพุ่มไม้
points.notes: A modest spirit house with a gold spire and white balustrade, half-screened by a bush and a papaya tree beside a construction-fenced lot; garlands not clearly visible but figurines are.

points.title: Two spirit houses at a gate
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิและศาลตายายที่หน้าประตูบ้าน
points.notes: A tall wooden spirit house and a smaller squat one share a plinth outside a grey block wall, with pink garlands and small figurine offerings.

points.title: A small golden spirit house on a traffic island
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองขนาดเล็กบนเกาะกลางถนน
points.notes: Golden spirit house with offering bowls at its base, standing on a pedestrian island at a major intersection; partly screened by a striped pole and a tree.

points.title: Spirit house at the Royal Peninsula Hotel
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิที่โรงแรม Royal Peninsula
points.notes: A tidy white spirit house on a pedestal with a small gilded figure, set among palms at the hotel's driveway; an offering bowl sits on a stand beside it.

points.title: Green spirit house by a gated driveway
points.title_th: ศาลเจ้าที่สีเขียวข้างทางเข้ารั้ว
points.notes: Chinese-temple-style green and gold spirit house with a horse or dog figurine and incense on the base; shaded, slightly dark exposure.

points.title: White spirit house at the Nidhra Lanna Hotel entrance
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีขาวหน้าโรงแรม Nidhra Lanna
points.notes: Ornate white Thai-style spirit house with a tiered spire and small figurines on the platform, backlit/in shadow under the hotel's covered entrance.

points.title: Garlanded spirit houses at a hotel entrance
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิคล้องพวงมาลัยหน้าโรงแรม
points.notes: A well-tended pair of spirit houses on a raised plinth, richly draped in orange and gold garlands, framed by tall palms beside the Amora hotel's driveway.

points.title: Royal portrait shrine by the moat
points.title_th: ศาลพระบรมฉายาลักษณ์ริมคูเมือง
points.notes: A gilt-framed portrait of the King and Queen on a gold pedestal with a small offering shelf, set in a flowerbed with the old city wall behind.

points.title: Small spirit house by a soi gate
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิเล็กๆ ข้างทางเข้าซอย
points.notes: A plain white spirit house on the boundary wall beside a driveway, simple but clear.

points.title: Spirit house at a framing shop
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิหน้าร้านกรอบรูป
points.notes: A plain white spirit house on a pedestal at the corner of a picture-framing shop, simple but clearly visible.

points.title: Ornate spirit house among purple flowers
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิลวดลายวิจิตรท่ามกลางดอกไม้สีม่วง
points.notes: A white-and-gold spirit house with a tiered naga roofline and a gilded figure inside, set among purple flowering shrubs -- unusually ornate for a roadside shrine.

points.title: Wat Pansao's red-roofed viharn with hanging lanterns
points.title_th: วิหารหลังคาแดงวัดปันเสาพร้อมโคมแขวน
points.notes: Carved gable and tiered red-tiled roof of the temple hall, with rows of colourful paper lanterns strung along the porch and a white chedi beside it.

points.title: Spirit house at the hospital gate
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิหน้าประตูโรงพยาบาล
points.notes: A well-kept spirit house at Chiangmai Ram Hospital's entrance garden, hung with garlands and offerings, gold spire catching the sun.

points.title: Elephant statue and shrine at a hotel entrance
points.title_th: รูปปั้นช้างและศาลเล็กหน้าโรงแรม
points.notes: A small grey elephant statue beside a tiered shrine ornament with a gold spire, at the porte-cochere of the De Khuvieng hotel.

points.title: Spirit house tied with a tricolour ribbon
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิผูกผ้าสามสี
points.notes: A bronze-toned spirit house on a carved pedestal, wrapped with a red-white-blue ribbon, beside a yellow noodle shop; a second spirit house stands just behind it.

points.title: Guardian yaksha at the temple gate
points.title_th: ยักษ์เฝ้าประตูวัด
points.notes: A golden-and-red yaksha guardian statue garlanded with offerings, set at the foot of an intricately carved brick archway into Wat Lok Moli.

points.title: Carved devata pillar at the shrine gate
points.title_th: เสาแกะสลักเทวดาที่ประตูศาล
points.notes: A deeply carved stone gatepost showing a standing devata figure in relief, marking the corner of the King Naresuan Shrine compound.

points.title: Golden singha and demon guardian
points.title_th: สิงห์ทองและยักษ์เฝ้าประตู
points.notes: A finely detailed golden singha crouched on a temple wall's white gable, a red-skinned demon figure kneeling beneath it in support, corner of an old brick boundary wall below.

points.title: Golden spirit house in a garage
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิทองในโรงรถ
points.notes: A small golden spirit house with a tiered spire, set on a white pedestal inside a dim garage, tiny figurines placed at its base.

points.title: Chao Pho Chang Phueak shrine at the roundabout
points.title_th: ศาลเจ้าพ่อช้างเผือกที่วงเวียน
points.notes: A monument with a black inscribed stone and a small Lanna-style tiered-roof pillar with a gold emblem, at the Chang Phueak roundabout; believed to be the guardian-spirit shrine the roundabout is named for.

points.title: Gilded guardian statue on the temple wall
points.title_th: เทวรูปยักษ์สีทองบนกำแพงวัด
points.notes: A gold-and-white guardian figure stands atop the boundary wall, half-hidden in foliage.

points.title: Golden spirit house and offering table on a street corner
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองและโต๊ะบูชาที่มุมถนน
points.notes: A tall gilded spirit house next to a plainer offering table, both on a raised concrete platform at a corner beside an LPG station; clean, uncluttered, well framed against a whitewashed wall.

points.title: Small gilded spirit house at a car showroom
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองเล็กๆ ที่โชว์รูมรถ
points.notes: A modest gilded spirit house tucked among potted plants at the entrance to a used-car lot, garlands draped on it.

points.title: Gateway of the Dev Mandir Hindu temple
points.title_th: ประตูวัดฮินดูเทพมณเฑียร
points.notes: Ornate maroon-and-gold gopuram-style gate with Om symbols and deity statues on top, gold gate below; a striking, unusual landmark on an ordinary Chiang Mai street.

points.title: Golden spirit house on a hedged corner
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองที่มุมพุ่มไม้
points.notes: A gilded spirit house set against a green hedge at a street corner, offerings visible at its base.

points.title: Gold-and-white spirit house on a naga pedestal
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองขาวบนแท่นลายนาคา
points.notes: An elaborate white-and-gold spirit house on a pedestal carved with a golden naga, displayed outside a statuary shop.

points.title: A banyan tree wrapped in a faded sash
points.title_th: ต้นไทรใหญ่พันผ้าแพรซีดจาง
points.notes: Massive gnarled roots and trunk of an old banyan/bodhi tree, wrapped chest-high with a faded cloth sash and hung with small amulets; close, sharp and full of texture.

points.title: Small gold spirit house at a corner shophouse
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองเล็กๆ มุมตึกแถว
points.notes: Modest guardian shrine tucked beside a teal shopfront; offerings not clearly visible at this distance.

points.title: Gold spirit house at a temple compound entrance
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองหน้าทางเข้าวัด
points.notes: Well-lit gold shrine on a raised platform with red-and-white offerings, framed by greenery; traffic cones nearby crop out easily.

points.title: Teochew clan hall gate
points.title_th: ประตูศาลเจ้าสมาคมแต้จิ๋ว
points.notes: Red iron fence with grey swags fronting a green-tiled Chinese clan-association hall; strong colour and roofline against a cloudy sky.

points.title: Spirit house behind the shrine fence
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิหลังรั้วศาลเจ้า
points.notes: Small wooden/stone spirit house with a peaked roof and offering bowl, tucked among plants inside the Teochew hall's grounds.

points.title: Chaeng Katam guardian shrine
points.title_th: ศาลเจ้าพ่อหลักเมืองแจ่งกระต๊ำ
points.notes: A dark-wood Thai shrine pavilion with gold trim and garlands under a big shade tree, offerings lined up at its base — the guardian spirit shrine of the Chaeng Katam corner.

points.title: White spirit house in a cafe courtyard
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีขาวในลานคาเฟ่
points.notes: small tiered-roof spirit house with flowers and figurine offerings, just inside a blue picket fence

points.title: Teochew association hall gate
points.title_th: ประตูสมาคมแต้จิ๋วเชียงใหม่
points.notes: Chinese-style association hall with a dragon-ridge tiled roof behind a red iron gate, white ceremonial cloth draped along the fence.

points.title: Gold spirit house among purple flowers
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองท่ามกลางดอกไม้สีม่วง
points.notes: An ornate, well-kept gold-and-white spirit house on a tiered pedestal, ringed by purple-flowering shrubs; clean composition against a dark wooden house.

points.title: Plain spirit house outside a framing shop
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิเรียบง่ายหน้าร้านกรอบรูป
points.notes: A small, plain white spirit house on a pedestal in front of a shophouse; modest but clearly visible.

points.title: Roadside spirit house before the Bangchak station
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิริมถนนก่อนถึงปั๊มบางจาก
points.notes: A plain white pedestal spirit house with a peaked, tiered roof, set in a grassy verge under a tree; clean and clearly lit despite the overcast sky.

points.title: Shrine at the foot of a banyan tree
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิที่โคนต้นไทร
points.notes: Two garlanded spirit-house shrines set into the buttress roots of a large banyan, orange marigolds fresh, motorcycles parked alongside for scale.

points.title: Gilded portrait shrine at the Ping River bridge
points.title_th: ศาลาทองประดิษฐานรูปภาพที่หัวสะพานแม่น้ำปิง
points.notes: Small gilded peaked shrine with a portrait inside and a Thai flag beside it, right at the bridge approach.

points.title: A blue-and-gold temple hall behind roadside trees
points.title_th: อาคารวัดสีฟ้าทองหลังต้นไม้ริมทาง
points.notes: Ornate gable and columns of a monastic hermitage hall (สำนักสงฆ์รัตนัย), glimpsed through big roadside trees.

points.title: A gold spirit house and a red-and-gold house shrine with a small white stupa, in a yard beside a pickup truck.
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองและศาลตายายสีแดงทอง พร้อมเจดีย์ขาวเล็ก ตั้งอยู่ในลานข้างรถกระบะ
points.notes: Two spirit houses of different styles side by side with a miniature white chedi; shot through the highway sound-barrier fence so mesh lines cross the image.

points.title: A whole shopfront of ornate spirit houses for sale, Chiang Mai's Om Wiang Spirit House shop.
points.title_th: หน้าร้านศาลพระภูมิลวดลายวิจิตรวางขายเต็มพื้นที่ ร้านเชียงใหม่ อ้อมเวียงศาลพระภูมิ
points.notes: Dozens of white-and-gold miniature shrines of different sizes and styles lined up for sale; a clean, well-lit daytime shot with a sign naming the shop.

points.title: A small gold spirit house by a building-materials yard
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองขนาดเล็กข้างร้านวัสดุก่อสร้าง
points.notes: Plain small gold spirit house on a pedestal among potted plants, next to a shed with a red pillar.

points.title: A small terracotta spirit house outside a fitness-equipment shop
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิดินเผาขนาดเล็กหน้าร้านอุปกรณ์ออกกำลังกาย
points.notes: Small plain terracotta-coloured spirit house on a post, with a model-house shrine next to it, in front of a shopfront.

points.title: A small gold spirit house by a bar entrance
points.title_th: ศาลพระภูมิสีทองเล็กหน้าร้านบาร์
points.notes: Small plain gold-roofed spirit house on a short post next to the patchwork-wood bar's entrance.

points.title: A roadside shrine with offerings by a loan-office pole
points.title_th: ศาลเล็กพร้อมเครื่องบูชาข้างเสาไฟหน้าสำนักงานสินเชื่อ
points.notes: Small shrine table with red garlands and potted flowers at the base of a utility pole.

points.title: A small white shrine by a clinic entrance
points.title_th: ศาลสีขาวเล็กหน้าคลินิก
points.notes: Small plain white shrine on a pedestal at the base of the entrance pole.

points.title: A small white shrine by a restaurant's outdoor seating
points.title_th: ศาลสีขาวเล็กข้างที่นั่งกลางแจ้งของร้านอาหาร
points.notes: Small plain white shrine on a pedestal beside the restaurant entrance and outdoor tables.
